artifacts.description: 單一reviewer-owned小證據：CPU人工logits/gradient、無權重greedy表、CLI help/parser/guard、資料規則、既存原始JSON/RNG重算、來源原檔收據及實讀定位。
artifacts.command: UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT=/workspace/tiny-perceptron-vlm/.venv PYTHONPATH=/workspace/work/omni-book-integrated-v1 uv run --extra cpu --group notebook --no-sync python /workspace/work/reference/omni-p6-wave04-T.10/review_probe.py; isolated status AST expression evaluated by /workspace/work/reference/omni-p6-wave04-T.10/build_report.py
artifacts.result: All probe assertions passed；另對原runner狀態式的三個人工metadata案例均符合預期。先前一個reviewer receipt path typo已如實記錄。

factual_accuracy.details: 逐核教師種類/來源、CE與教師KL、共享控制、字表/答案對齊、兩種joint及選讀依賴；全節與選讀無未核實實質主張。

numeric_verification.details: 六個L4時間從原始elapsed_seconds四捨五入；核width32、24-token上限、split與有效目標分母，並重算十題ID匹配和CPU人工KL/梯度。未重新神經訓練或正式評估。

figure_consistency.details: 凍結T.10正文與選讀沒有SVG/圖像引用；figure_sha256與freeze v8同為{}。

source_verification.details: 實讀Hinton1503.02531v1原論文、PyTorch官方v2.14.1原碼、OpenAI pinned GSM8K README；本專案契約核現行完整檔SHA，實測數字核各組原始JSON，未使用舊審閱/作者摘要作權威。

limitations.details: 時間只屬六個歷史L4單次執行；CPU可行性未經本審閱測量。小例/成功argmax/梯度/原始hash比對不代表重訓成功。未載入權重、teacher forward、formal final、GPU/Modal/付費/發布；GSM8K只兩題域外診斷，蒸餾與量化各自驗收。

independence.visible_materials: Only assigned frozen T.10 and its explicit prerequisite sections/recipes, generic protocols/neutral locations, primary original sources, implementation and preserved generated raw results. No old issue packet, old review report, peer verdict or author rationale was read.
independence.review_role: Technical review only; no textbook/source/figure/checker edits.
independence.raw_results_scope: Preserved course-experiment JSONs are original generated execution records, not technical-review verdicts. They were recomputed, not rerun.

execution_scope: CPU synthetic logits/gradient and scripted score generation, CLI help/parser/guards and pure recomputation of existing JSON. No model weights loaded, teacher forward, training, optimizer step, final evaluation, Modal/GPU, paid compute or publishing.

original_report.receipt_provenance: Root explicitly confirmed opening and parsing this original before current creation.

current_review_note: 同一fresh reviewer在root真收件後另存完整schema current；重新核對freeze v8、現行T.10、所有程式來源與唯一artifact SHA均未改變。未提供或閱讀任何舊issue/舊review/peer verdict；判定與原判相同，教材未改。
